messages:
sre-oncall: Heads-up: Were running a planned cross-region peering switch and egress IP rotation tomorrow 03/25 03:00-03:20 UTC. This is a drill to validate routing failover and our CDN/egress gating. Expect brief (<60s) routing blips for affected regions and ephemeral 502/504s for a subset of requests. Please monitor console and alarms. Runbook: https://intranet.redwood/runbooks/peering-rotation
ops-bot: Calendar event created: Cross-region peering switch (03/25 03:00 UTC) — attendees: #eng-sre, oncall@sre.redwood.com :calendar:
Maya (SRE): Copy. Which regions are in scope?
Jamal: EU-west + US-west primary peering will flip to secondary. APAC not affected.
Olga: Will this change NAT egress IPs for Dedicated customers?
Jamal: Yes for a small subset of Dedicated clusters that are behind the old peering. Well post new egress IP list to the portal as soon as rotation completes.
Kat: Alerting ask: can we add a temporary burn-rate alert for model-inference-5xx >= 1% sustained for 5m?
Maya (SRE): Good call. Ill add a detection rule and a dashboard card for token latency p95.
Leo: Can we pause automatic canary rollouts during the window? Id prefer no model rollouts while network topology is changing.
Jamal: Agreed. Ill set the rollout lock to manual at 02:45 UTC.
Maya (SRE): Quick check command to watch edge health:
```bash
curl -sS -H "Host: infer.redwood.ai" https://edge-probe.redwood.ai/health | jq .
```
Maya (SRE): If you see staleness in kv-cache-hit-rate dashboards, let us know. Were targeting warmup within 2 minutes of failover.
Olga: Noted. Ill keep an eye on per-customer egress logs for any TLS handshake failures.
sre-oncall: Escalation: if model-serving 5xx > 2% for >5m, page oncall@sre and infra-oncall.
ops-bot: PagerDuty: oncall@sre paged (incident simulated: peering-switch-drill).
Jamal: Preflight checklist pinned: - update firewall allowlist - pre-warm KV cache - lock rollouts - notify sales ops - create egress-IP diff post-switch
Maya (SRE): ETA for firewall updates?
Jamal: Done at 02:20 UTC in all affected regions.
Kat: Adding note: customers with IP allowlists might see blocked traffic; well push an email to customers 12h before.
Leo: Im standing by to abort rotation if latency spike persists beyond 6m.
Olga: First 10m after switch: small uptick in 502s in eu-west (0.8% -> 1.5%), p95 latency +80ms. Monitoring closely.
Maya (SRE): Observed kv-warmup hit 45s, within expected. No SLO breach yet.
Olga: After 3m, error rate falling back to baseline. Looks like warmup did the trick.
Jamal: Rotation complete for EU/US-west at 03:07 UTC. Pushed egress IP diff to portal: https://portal.redwood/egress-ips/diff/1961234567
Maya (SRE): Thanks. Ill remove the temporary burn-rate alert in 30m if stable.
Leo: Canary rollouts unlocked at 03:30 UTC.
Kat: Customer comms queued and sent at 03:15 UTC.
Olga: Closing note: no Dedicated customer-facing incidents reported. Logging and metrics retained.
sre-oncall: Drill complete; summary and postmortem will be posted in #eng-sre/postmortems by EOD. :white_check_mark:
